answer: A head may act only while it holds a plot in the garden, and no stranger sponsors a root twice. The garden admits the k-th plot of a root only once k sponsors have each staked jade into the nadir, and if the plot is judged a clone the nadir keeps that jade. An honest newcomer needs one sponsor and one jade; a thousand clones of one root need half a million sponsors and half a million jade, and the garden counts funders, not wallets.
